entities.summary: Ceretic Guletic was a prominent economist and social scientist of the Classical era, active in Global. Born in an unknown location, he died in 440 CE. Known for his work in monarchs & rulers, he contributed to the development of economic theories and social structures in the region. His influence can be seen in the governance of various empires and civilizations during this period. Guletic's legacy extends to the understanding of social hierarchies and economic systems, shaping the course of human history in the region. He was a key figure in the development of philosophical inquiry and foundational civilizations, leaving a lasting impact on the world. His contributions to the field of economics and social science are still studied and debated by scholars today.
